propositions: _paged_search lacks an offset-stall guard and spins indefinitely when a server ignores or repeats startAt offsets instead of advancing pagination
fail-open exception handlers at get_parent_map and three fetch_snapshot enrichment sites swallow pagination stall errors, converting loud abort signals into silent degraded snapshots
_paged_search must raise BackendPaginationStallError when a repeated page is detected (same first-issue key), triggering on the second call to abort loudly
stall errors must be re-raised past all four fail-open boundaries (transport, _hierarchy, and three fetcher enrichment handlers) to propagate as loud failures rather than degraded reads

DC pagination must raise on ANY repeated page regardless of length, unlike fetcher which returns on short pages, because DC caps every page short and a short page is the normal case with more data to give
